title: Understanding crypto market volatility
summary: Crypto prices can move quickly in both directions. Reviewing longer-term context, rather than reacting to a single price move, is a common approach among long-term holders.

title: What moves crypto prices?
summary: Crypto asset prices are influenced by supply and demand, broader market sentiment, regulatory news, and macroeconomic conditions -- often all at once.

title: Why diversifying research sources matters
summary: No single news source captures the full picture. Reviewing multiple perspectives before forming a view is a widely recommended habit for crypto investors of every experience level.

title: HODLing versus active trading
summary: Some investors prefer holding assets over long periods, while others trade more actively. Neither approach is guaranteed to outperform the other, and both carry risk.
